results.title: Pace
results.overview: After serving a prison sentence, 40-year old Malcolm is intent on rebuilding his life. He looks for purpose in his late brother’s passion for running and trains to run a full marathon. Confronted with unresolved family expectations, a judgemental society and destructive self-loathing, can Malcolm keep pace, or will he succumb to the unrelenting tempo of society?

results.title: Don't Sleep Alone
results.overview: After her father's suicide, Sami returns to her childhood home to reunite with her family. At night, she begins to suffer episodes of sleep paralysis, blurring the line between reality and nightmare, and is visited by a presence seemingly tied to what happened. What Sami ultimately uncovers will force them to confront a truth far more disturbing than her father's death.

results.title: Illios
results.overview: Under the Thessaloniki sun, Elsa, a professional singer, is raising her eight-year-old daughter on her own following the sudden death of her husband. Through songs, conversations and scenes of the local landscape, the film tells the story of how music and the support of a female vocal group helped her cope with her grief and begin to heal. It tells the story of how, in the wake of tragedy, she managed to find light again.

results.title: New Year's Concert 2026
results.overview: The Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra welcomes in the New Year as the world watches: 50 million classical music fans tune in to the New Year's Concert from the flower-decorated Golden Hall of the Musikverein.

results.title: It Ain't Me
results.overview: A young woman must face her worst decision to confront an abusive relationship.

results.title: Almost Pink
results.overview: After basketball practice, a 15-year-old girl meets a stranger for a transaction that goes almost as planned. Confronted with her own limits, she will come to harshly realize her place in the real world, beyond the court.

results.title: Writing Life – Annie Ernaux Through the Eyes of High School Students
results.original_title: Écrire la vie - Annie Ernaux racontée par des lycéennes et des lycéens
results.overview: A major figure in contemporary feminism and the first Frenchwoman to win the Nobel Prize for Literature, Annie Ernaux is seen by many as a source of individual and collective emancipation, blending the intimate with the universal. Filmmaker Claire Simon has devoted an original portrait to her, giving students and teachers a voice.

results.title: Magic
results.overview: Adèle attends her high school reunion. Adèle has lost weight. She comes face to face with those who never appreciated her. She is transformed, like a magic trick revealed in broad daylight.

results.title: Bloodline
results.overview: Set against the systemic oppression of Chinese American communities, this elegant, spine-chilling drama follows two siblings in 1952 Utah as they search for their family's hidden treasure.

results.title: Yugo Goes to America
results.overview: Three young friends from Belgrade drive from New York to Los Angeles in a Yugo – a cult relic of a car from the 1980s. A docu-comedy and a road trip with many unexpected encounters.

results.title: Transmutation
results.overview: A spiral of dreams and ages unravel as two celestial characters awaken and transmutate into a mythological being.
The experience of Maya's grief and despair from a past traumatic experience.

results.title: STYMIE
results.overview: A documentary based on the word 'stymie'.

results.title: Izhakalkkappuram
results.overview: In an ancestral home, Dr. Ananth Sivan, an ageing Gandhian scholar, holds firmly to his lifelong beliefs, while his filmmaker daughter Karthi begins to question his convictions. Through their everyday interactions, their relationship unfolds as they navigate the delicate space between ideals, belief, and empathy.

results.title: That's My Sister
results.overview: When Camille, a teenager with Down’s syndrome, auditions for a dance troupe, her sister Agathe discovers the quiet cruelty of prejudice – and the fierce love that fights back.

results.title: A Life, A Manifesto
results.overview: The life of Michèle Firk — a trailblazing French journalist, film critic, aspiring director and communist activist involved in various liberation struggles in the second half of the 20th century — as told by narrator Alice Diop, modern day French director.
